purpose: Every decision this contract took that a reader could reasonably have taken differently, with what it rested on. STATUS.json says what the evidence supports; this says what was CHOSEN, and where a choice is still open it says so rather than resolving it in the report's favour.
generated: after the registered runs landed; regenerated by hand only, never inferred from a status

EVALUATION_VALIDITY.rule: This field is capped at PARTIAL while any open question can move a calibration number that a reported conclusion cites. It is not a summary of how many checks passed; 19/19 validator checks passing does not lift it.

what_is_open.observed: the post-D13 rollout-bias remeasurement moved root-only optimism 0.201 -> 0.6003 while the opposing seat moved 0.601 -> 0.3281 -- the two seats effectively exchanged values, and the turn-capped fraction fell 0.197 -> 0.0778
two_readings_neither_excluded: D13's payload fix was real and the pre-D13 rollouts were scored from the wrong side of a turn boundary, making the OLD 0.201 the opponent's win rate under the root player's name
the probe's twelve frozen roots redrew between runs -- the environment reseeds itself and twelve is a small sample -- though a near-exact swap is a strange coincidence for sampling to produce
what_is_open.what_it_affects: the EXPLANATION offered for the ~21 pp residual overconfidence in the 96-simulation arms, which cites the pre-D13 ceiling
what_is_open.what_it_does_NOT_affect: the compute-vs-ensemble decomposition, which compares three measured arms and never references the ceiling; and M08's registered pass condition, which is a comparison between arms
what_is_open.the_experiment_that_would_settle_it: score the probe's rollouts for BOTH seats on the SAME frozen roots under the pre- and post-D13 payload paths, isolating a payload effect from a sampling effect
what_is_open.why_it_was_not_run: time, not method. The method is written down.

decisions.decision: report that 98.8% of the calibration improvement is simulations and 1.2% is the ensemble, overturning the contract's own premise

decisions.could_have_gone_otherwise: the fixed_per_world pair alone reads as a large ensemble win. Not running the control would have produced a defensible-looking positive result.
decisions.confidence: high -- three 200-game arms, and the ensemble step is four times smaller than the difference between two accidentally identical arms

decisions.rested_on: the frozen bar re-run on the same panel scores 0.5833 against the best candidate's 0.1333, and the candidate wins 0 of 45 games against three of four opponents
decisions.rule: DECISION_RULES §5 forbids submitting without a credible gate; §2 forbids reading a small noisy improvement as a competitive pass

decisions.decision: at 9-11% of the matched budget, report the flat trajectory as unresolved rather than as method failure
decisions.rested_on: FIDELITY_RULES §5, taken as binding before the extension arm existed
decisions.vindicated_by: the extension arm at 73% of the budget separates from the random floor; the flatness was budget
decisions.confidence: high, and it is worth noting the decision was made when the evidence did not yet support it

decisions.decision: record the ensemble-at-depth question as blocked rather than reporting the arms that ran
decisions.rested_on: k8_s768 abandoned 62.5% of its games against a comparison arm's 0%, violating the registered 8pp exclusion gate sevenfold; the 4x retry ran to its arm timeout
decisions.cause: ~29 ms per simulation makes a per-game guard sized to meaningful depth unaffordable at 40 games
decisions.confidence: high that the arms are invalid; the question itself is untested

decisions.decision: write a c022 provider rather than run transfer from a c021 checkpoint
decisions.rested_on: MANDATORY_IMPLEMENTATION C asks about a component of the PUBLISHED system; c021's arms are recorded UNTESTED because their checkpoint was indistinguishable from an untrained floor
decisions.adaptation_declared: the recurrent state is ZEROED per query, because an MCGS node has no episode history. A null result is evidence about a stateless query of a recurrent policy, not about the policy.
decisions.confidence: the implementation is sound; the adaptation is a real weakening and is recorded as one

decisions.rested_on: MANDATORY_IMPLEMENTATION: 'Do not add multiple ByteRL components to MCGS simultaneously.' The registered protocol isolates one component per arm, and a combined arm cannot attribute its own result.
decisions.confidence: high -- this is a prohibition, not a preference

decisions.decision: quarantine the 07:50 empty summaries and make the validator reject their shape
decisions.rested_on: a provider load failure wrote completed:0 summaries into the LIVE transfer directories, where any glob would read them as results
decisions.guard: V20 rejects on four independent criteria -- completed-game count consistent with raw records, summary newer than the quarantine directory, configuration matching the T0 control on every held-constant field, and a nonzero component call count

how_to_read_a_transfer_result_here.equal_simulation_conclusion: T1/T2 are budgeted by SIMULATION COUNT at 12 per world with a decision budget of 50, identical to the T0 control. A difference in field score at equal simulations is a statement about the component.
how_to_read_a_transfer_result_here.wall_clock_deployment_conclusion: SEPARATE and not interchangeable. The provider costs an LSTM forward pass per query, which competes with search under the per-game wall guard. If an arm abandons more games or searches fewer decisions than its control, part of any regression is the guard biting on inference cost.
how_to_read_a_transfer_result_here.the_check_that_separates_them: compare searched_decisions, decision_budget_exhausted_decisions and abandoned across arms. If they differ materially, the equal-simulation reading is compromised and only the deployment reading survives.
how_to_read_a_transfer_result_here.the_error_this_prevents: attributing a regression to the learned component when the component simply bought fewer searches. That is the D08/D15 confound in a new place.
